steps.label: docker
steps.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2

steps.label: up
steps.cmd: docker rm -f spawnables-excalidraw >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --restart unless-stopped --name spawnables-excalidraw -p 8080:8080 -v /opt/spawnables-services/excalidraw:/data excalidraw/excalidraw:latest

notes: the whiteboard, self-hosted, no account and no telemetry. honest limit: collab rooms need a separate excalidraw-room container, so this is single-user drawing on localhost until that is added. version tag is 'latest' today and the card says so rather than pretending a pin.
